predecessors.name: Gojoseon (Old Joseon)
predecessors.text: Lintun, whose 'border is almost the same as the current Gangwon Province' (Lintun page), main office Dongyi prefecture (Gangneung)

successors.name: Dongye (Eastern Ye)
successors.text: Lintun, whose 'border is almost the same as the current Gangwon Province' (Lintun page), main office Dongyi prefecture (Gangneung)

successors.name: Xuantu Commandery
successors.text: the prefectures that stayed after 82 BCE (new Dongyi at Wonsan, Buer at Anbyon)

ledger.x: 108 BCE: the Han found Lintun on the east coast.
82 BCE: most of Lintun is abandoned.
82 BCE: the rest of Lintun is merged into Xuantu.

wars.name: Han conquest of Wiman Joseon
wars.outcome: The Han destroy Wiman Chosŏn in 108 BCE and set up Lelang, Lintun and Zhenfan (Four Commanderies page).

certainty.note: The page gives a modern province and a list of prefectures, no boundary.
